lib/wordpress.ts.note: The one place that talks to WordPress: types for the ACF fields, a fetch helper with revalidation, and one function per query. acf_format=standard returns the cover as an image object.

app/books/page.tsx.note: The books list. Fetches books and genres in parallel; the cover's width and height come straight from ACF.

app/books/[slug]/page.tsx.note: One page per book, generated at build time, with ACF's cover (and its alt text) as the sharing image.

app/layout.tsx.note: The shared HTML shell for every page.

.env.example.note: The only setting: the address of your WordPress site.

package.json.note: Next.js, React and TypeScript. Nothing else is needed.

README.md.note: What the WordPress side needs (CPT UI + ACF), and how to run it.
